components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address

## Summary

I implemented household-duplicate rejection on `POST /api/owners`: a create is now rejected with **409** when another owner has the same `lastName` **and** `address` (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace), unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

Changes, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` exposes `getSharesHousehold()`. Write-only keeps it out of owner responses; MapStruct ignores the unmapped source property.

2. **`CheckUniqueOwnerHousehold`** (new function) — reads the published `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`, short-circuits when `sharesHousehold` is true, otherwise compares the request's normalized `lastName`+`address` against every existing owner and throws `DuplicateHouseholdException` on a match. Normalization lower-cases (Locale.ROOT) and collapses whitespace. It uses `findAll()` rather than `findByLastName` because the active Spring Data query is a case-sensitive `LIKE` prefix, which would miss case variants the spec requires catching.

3. **`DuplicateHouseholdException`** (checked) + **`DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler`** (responds 409 with an `errors` body naming `lastName`/`address`), plus the escalation YAML mapping — mirroring the existing `DuplicateTelephone` pattern.

4. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted a `checkHousehold` step after the telephone-uniqueness check and before `build`, under the same `transaction` governance, so no owner is created on conflict.
